ddl.name: core_jobs_dedupe
ddl.where: dedupe_key IS NOT NULL AND state IN ('queued', 'running')

ddl.name: core_accounts_not_merged_into_itself
ddl.value: merged_into_id IS NULL OR merged_into_id <> id

ddl.name: core_accounts_name_length
ddl.value: name IS NULL OR length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120

ddl.name: core_accounts_pronouns_length
ddl.value: pronouns IS NULL OR length(pronouns) BETWEEN 1 AND 40

ddl.name: core_grants_scope
ddl.value:
(scope = 'site' AND scope_module IS NULL AND scope_type IS NULL AND scope_id IS NULL)
      OR (scope = 'module' AND scope_module IS NOT NULL AND scope_type IS NULL AND scope_id IS NULL)
      OR (scope = 'record' AND scope_module IS NOT NULL AND scope_type IS NOT NULL AND scope_id IS NOT NULL)
